set.approach: Park at the northern terminus of the Wapack Trail and hike south to the summit of North Pack. From there head east on the Cliff Trail to the top of the cliff, then walk down and around through the scree field to the base. The route starts on a black band of rock just right of Backpack.
set.descent_text: There are no bolted anchors or rappel stations on top, so the way down is the walk around the cliff through the scree field, reached from the Cliff Trail above.

review.notes: Approach and descent walk from the area page; start from the route page.
